notes: A target drone of the weapons range (avionics-plan.md §6 slice 1): the sim's own F-16 flown by the shared AI under a range brain (data/db/brains); clean, no stores and no gun, so it never shoots. Not flyable (no "airframe"): the Hangar lists only the jets with one.
notes.type: the F-16's type code (100): its flight model and its look follow the F-16 switch the player's jet sets (Sufa or Barak)
notes.model: our F-16 model's file name in the sim's own aircraft index (iaf-sim own, converted/own/planes): the AI flies it as that plane
notes.scale: 1: our models are built true size
notes.radius_m: half the span over the wingtip rails, 9.96 m

footnotes.w-f16: Wikipedia, "General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon" (span 32 ft 8 in, 9.96 m), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/General_Dynamics_F-16_Fighting_Falcon
